description: Abort: the requested idea is already implemented, since setup_optimizer groups Muon params by shape and muon_step_fused runs Newton-Schulz once per shape group.

Sequence-length curriculum: for the first 30% of the time budget, reshape each micro-batch from (64, 2048) to (128, 1024) so tokens per optimizer step stay identical, then switch to full 2048-token context for the rest of training.
Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.025 to improve val_bpb while keeping all other hyperparameters identical.
Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.1 to end the learning rate warmdown at 10 percent of the peak learning rate.
Abort: the initial-embedding residual skip is already implemented as per-layer resid_lambdas and x0_lambdas that mix the residual stream with the normalized embedding x0 at every block.
Reduce Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 3 in the Muon optimizer to save compute and allow more training steps in the fixed 300s budget.

Add a learned scalar gate (initialized to 0) that mixes the previous token's normalized input embedding into each position, with the first position receiving no addition, and register the gate in the scalar AdamW group so the optimizer parameter-count assertion still holds.

description: Reduced WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1 for the Muon optimizer to improve val_bpb.

Deepen the model from 8 to 10 layers and lower ASPECT_RATIO to 48 so that width is about 480, which rounds up to 512 at HEAD_DIM 128, the same width as the baseline; optimizer and other settings are unchanged.
Set WINDOW_PATTERN from "SSSL" to "L" so every layer uses full-context causal attention instead of half-context sliding windows.
Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to increase optimizer steps under the fixed time budget, potentially improving convergence for a small model.
Separate weight decay for embeddings by setting weight_decay to 0.0 for embedding and lm_head parameter groups, matching the existing optimization strategy.

Maintain an exponential moving average of all trainable parameters (decay 0.999, with a short warmup so early random init is not averaged in), update it after every optimizer step, and swap the EMA weights into the model just before the existing final evaluation.
Added global gradient norm clipping before optimizer steps to prevent parameter explosion from high learning rates.

issues: Nothing found on integrity. The diff changes one hyperparameter, HEAD_DIM from 128 to 64. It does not touch the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines, the prepare.py import line or the evaluation call.

I found no bug that would make the result meaningless. model_dim = depth * 64 divides exactly by a head dimension of 64, so the head count simply doubles and the model still builds and trains correctly.

The z value of -0.019 cannot be recomputed because each side has only one run, so no variance is available, and the noise sigma the harness used is not given. The sign and size still look right: the candidate's 1.099 is 0.0001 worse than the incumbent's 1.0989, which implies a sigma of about 0.005.
The provisional decision to reject matches the numbers: the change brings no measurable gain, and one run per side cannot separate a difference of 0.0001 from noise.

description: Change HEAD_DIM from 128 to 64 so the 512-dim model has 8 attention heads of size 64 instead of 4 of size 128, testing whether finer-grained heads help at this scale.
Double TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2^18 to 2^20 (+40% tokens) to test lower noise-at-feasible-cost trade-off against the incumbent 2^18.
Modified the Muon optimizer's polar express step to scale the orthogonalized update gradient by 0.2 * sqrt(max(rows, cols)) to match AdamW-style magnitude across varying matrix shapes.
Adding a no-dropout control check to verify if regularization is wasting capacity.
Add a ResFormer-style value residual: block 0's value tensor is passed to later blocks and mixed in with a per-layer learnable scalar lam (init 0.5) that lives in the SCALAR_LR Adam group.

Replace the ReLU-squared MLP with a SwiGLU MLP (gate and up projections to a hidden size of round(8/3 * n_embd) to the nearest multiple of 64, SiLU(gate) * up, then down projection), with the new matrices initialized in init_weights and still grouped under Muon.
Abort the document-boundary attention masking idea: it cannot be implemented as a minimal edit under the harness constraints.
Abort: the idea is already implemented, since init_weights already zeros attn.c_proj and mlp.c_proj weights, so no edit is needed.

issues: No integrity problems found. The diff does not touch the seed lines, the prepare.py import, the data, the evaluation call or the final summary printing.

The change is architectural. It keeps n_layer//2 unique blocks and runs them twice (block i % n_shared), adds a learnable 2-element loop_gate on each block's residual delta, and raises ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 80 (a wider model). Per-layer resid/x0 lambdas, value embeddings and window sizes are still indexed over all n_layer passes, which is consistent. loop_gate is added to resid_params, so the parameter-count assert still holds.

Latent bug that does not apply to this run: if n_layer is odd, i // n_shared can reach 2 and index past the end of loop_gate (size 2). If n_layer == 1, n_shared is 0 and i % 0 raises an error. The run finished, so n_layer was even and the result is valid.
Side note: gating the delta (x - x_in) also scales the block's internal residual contributions. That is intended and causes no harm.
The numbers support the reject. The candidate scored 1.1419 against the incumbent's 1.0989, which is 0.0430 bpb worse. The negative z fits a regression under a lower-is-better convention.

I can't recompute z independently. Each side has only one run and no noise standard deviation was given. The reported z = -5.549 implies a reference sigma of about 0.00775 (0.0430/5.549), which is plausible for run-to-run noise but can't be checked here.
The diff makes no claims that conflict with the numbers. The provisional decision to reject is correct.

description: Share weights across depth by storing DEPTH//2 blocks and applying them twice with a learned per-pass residual gate (init 1), and widen the model by setting ASPECT_RATIO 64 to 80 (model_dim 512 to 640, HEAD_DIM kept at 128).
Increase WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 to extend the linear learning rate decay period.
